fact: The National Bureau of Statistics released Population and Vital Statistics December 2025 on 31 March 2026, reporting 1,293 births and 845 deaths registered in 2025, with figures taken from the Civil Status office.

The National Bureau of Statistics released Population and Vital Statistics December 2025 (catalogue Population 2026/1) on 31 March 2026, compiled from Civil Status registered births and deaths and covering 2025.

Seychelles Nation stated on 10 August 2018 that vital statistics compiled by the NBS from Civil Status records are published by the NBS on a bi-annual basis in electronic publications; no report, edition or release date is named, so the article date is used.

The Ministry of Health published its Annual Vital Statistics Report 2024 in March 2025 (figures cover 2024), drawing on Department of Civil Status registrations (1,333 live births, 850 deaths, named as the primary source and legal authority) cross-verified with hospital, maternity, mortuary and Statistics Unit records.
